reason: Having refused third-party cloud tools for years out of fear of client data leaks, I am not going to pay for an annual subscription until I personally test and verify that their Google Drive permissions and Trainee Laptop Shield are foolproof. Plus, with article clerks rotating every two to three years, I refuse to spend money on any tool that requires time-consuming training.
objection: I am deeply skeptical about connecting any third-party app to our Google Drive, and I worry whether the Trainee Laptop Shield can actually prevent rotating article clerks from saving client PAN and ITR data to their personal laptops.
would_change_my_mind: Independently verifying on the free pilot that Docketra is strictly quarantined to its own folder with zero access to outside files, and seeing foolproof proof that article assistants cannot download raw client documents.
